Book a visit

Our Shomoukh team is eager to welcome you. Book a tour and visit Shomoukh nursery school together with your child during working hours.

PREPARING FOR YOUR VISIT

What to Expect During Your Campus Tour

We want your visit to be informative, relaxed, and engaging for both you and your child.

45-Minute Guided Tour

A thorough walk through active learning spaces, gymnasiums, and ateliers conducted during working school hours.

Bring Your Child

We encourage children to explore materials in our ateliers so they feel comfortable, excited, and welcome from day one.

Q&A With Educators

Discuss developmental milestones, language learning, schedule flexibility, and enrollment availability with our heads of school.
